name.ja: 30MP 式波・アスカ・ラングレー(プラグスーツVer.)

description.ja: 30 MINUTES LABEL 「30 MINUTES PREFERENCE」より『ヱヴァンゲリヲン新劇場版』に登場する式波・アスカ・ラングレーをプラグスーツ姿で商品化！
description.en: 30 MINUTES LABEL From "30 MINUTES PREFERENCE ", Shikinami Asuka Langley who appears in " Evangelion Rebuild" is commercialized in a plug suit!

description.ja: ■2種類のタンポ印刷済のフェイスパーツが付属。
description.en: • Comes with two types of face parts with tampo printing.

description.ja: ■印刷無しのフェイスパーツと表情再現用の水転写式デカールが付属。
description.en: • Comes with unprinted face parts and water transfer decals to recreate facial expressions.
• Comes with the Spear of Cassius.

description.ja: ■座り用の交換パーツが付属。
description.en: • Comes with replacement parts for sitting.

description.ja: ■プラグスーツは艶のある質感で表現。
description.en: • The plug suit has a glossy texture.
